definitions.gloss: to comply with; to observe; to abide by (rules, laws, regulations)
definitions.explanation: To follow and adhere to rules, laws, regulations, or standards. A formal word used in legal, business, and institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遵守|じゅんしゅ}する。
⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧して⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遵守|じゅんしゅ}する⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: All employees have a duty to comply with company regulations.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧, a compound of {遵|じゅん} (follow, obey) and {守|しゅ} (protect, observe). Very formal; a key term in legal compliance, corporate governance, and regulatory contexts. Sometimes read as そんしゅ, though じゅんしゅ is the standard modern reading.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the rules being followed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{法令|ほうれい}{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→法令遵守：20007_houreijunshu⟧ — legal compliance (⟦コンプライアンス→コンプライアンス：06379_konpuraiansu⟧)
- ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遵守|じゅんしゅ}する — to observe rules
- ⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ — matters to be observed
- ⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ — obligation to comply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ — to protect, to observe (rules) (more casual, everyday)
- ⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ — to follow, to obey (broader, includes following people)
- ⟦コンプライアンス→コンプライアンス：06379_konpuraiansu⟧ — compliance (loanword, common in business)
